newsitem.title: USA: Hartford Q4 core earnings $1.65-shr vs $1.04.
newsitem.headline: Hartford Q4 core earnings $1.65-shr vs $1.04.

text.p: For the fourth quarter ended December 31:
(All data above in millions, except per share number.)
NOTE: Full company name is ITT Hartford Group Inc.

For the 1996 fourth quarter, the company's per-share net income was $1.75 including North American Property-Casaulty catastrophe and weather related losses, as well as environmental activity, compared with $1.20 per share in the 1995 fourth quarter.

For the 1996 full year, the company lost $0.84 per share including North American Property-Casulty catastrophe and weather related losses, as well as environmental activity, compared with a profit of $4.77 per share for the 1995 full year.
